title: Temporal Consistency Improves Generalization in Contextual Offline Meta Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.02935v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline meta-reinforcement learning seeks to learn a policy that generalizes to new related tasks online. Context-based methods infer a task representation from transition histories, yet learning an effective task representation without supervision remains challenging. Existing methods relying on contrastive learning learn discriminative task representations, but fail to identify task-specific dynamics, while relying on reconstruction can be insufficient to model long-horizon dependencies, limiting generalization to new tasks. We investigate the impact of temporal consistency in latent space on task representation learning, showing that enforcing multi-step predictions in latent space encourages task representations that are able to capture task-dependent dynamics while preventing representation collapse. We provide theoretical analysis characterizing sources of error in value estimation and show through extensive experiments on MuJo

translated_title: 时序一致性提升情境式离线元强化学习的泛化能力
translated_abstract: 离线元强化学习旨在学习一个能够在线泛化到新的相关任务的策略。基于情境（context）的方法从转移历史中推断任务表示，然而在无监督的情况下学习有效的任务表示仍然具有挑战性。现有依赖对比学习的方法能够学习具有判别性的任务表示，但无法识别任务特定的动力学；而依赖重构的方法可能不足以建模长时程依赖关系，从而限制了对新任务的泛化能力。我们研究了潜在空间中的时序一致性对任务表示学习的影响，结果表明在潜在空间中强制执行多步预测能够促使任务表示捕捉任务相关的动力学，同时防止表示坍塌。我们提供了刻画价值估计误差来源的理论分析，并通过在MuJoCo上的大量实验验证了方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出在潜在空间中强制多步预测的时序一致性约束，使任务表示既能捕捉任务特定的动力学又能避免表示坍塌，从而提升情境式离线元强化学习对新任务的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that enforcing temporal consistency through multi-step predictions in latent space yields task representations that capture task-specific dynamics while preventing representation collapse, thereby improving generalization in contextual offline meta-reinforcement learning.
